# volcano_service_key (Resource)

A project service key: an admin credential that bypasses Row-Level Security. Backend use only - never expose it to a frontend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_service_key" "jobs" {
  project_id  = volcano_project.example.id
  name        = "background-jobs"
  permissions = ["functions.invoke", "locks.manage"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `permissions` (List of String) Least-privilege scope for the key. Omit (or pass ["*"]) for full admin access. Forces replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_prefix` (String) First 12 characters of the key, for display/identification.
- `key_value` (String, Sensitive) Full JWT for the Authorization header.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_service_key.jobs <project-id>,<key-id>
```
